paragraphs.source_en: 12 A Disease of Perception “It’s a fair point, Ana. Employee wellbeing and productivity are impacted by many different factors, some of which are simply outside of an individual’s control. I didn’t choose that project deadline, and it wasn’t my fault that everyone couldn’t fit comfortably on the same floor.” Ana nodded. “But there were things I could have done differently,” Theo continued. “Instead of isolating myself and indulging in my self-pity, I could have reached out to the people it was my job to coordinate and collaborate with. I can’t have been the only one having a challenging time, and I certainly wasn’t the only one who was working hard. And just think of how much sooner I could have learned about the catering if I had gone upstairs where the teamwork was happening! “I wasn’t seeing things clearly. I was focused on myself and making excuses.
